text:
marco: Quick flag — after a few rapid workspace switches the console showed results from the previous workspace for the saved-search panel. Not consistent but reproducible for me.

sara: repro steps?

marco: 1) goto workspace /w/alpha 2) open saved search 'billing-active' 3) quick-switch -> /w/beta 4) open Insights -> saved searches panel -> observe rows with orgid:alpha

marco: saw this twice in the last hour on staging, attaching the network trace snippet:

marco: ```http
GET /api/internal/console/saved-searches?workspace=beta
Host: console.staging.redwood.ai
x-workspace-id: beta
x-user: sara
x-request-id: req_0a1b2c
Response 200
payload: { searches: [ ...rows with org_id: "alpha" ... ] }
```

jess: hmm could be caching layer returning stale snapshot keyed incorrectly. Which cache is fronting saved-searches? query-cache or preview-prefetch?

ryan: preview-prefetch uses a composite key [workspace, user, route]. If any header missing during the quick-switch race, key could collapse to previous workspace. marco, can you dump full request headers from your trace?

marco: full headers excerpt:

marco: ```
:authority: console.staging.redwood.ai
:method: GET
x-workspace-id: beta
x-session: sess_321
referer: https://console.staging/w/alpha/insights
user-agent: ...
x-prefetch: true
```

marco: I noticed referer still points at /w/alpha when the response contained alpha rows.

sara: That sounds like a prefetch race — prefetch kicked off before quick-switch completed, then UI navigated and requested same endpoint but different workspace, headers mismatch.

jess: If prefetch request uses referer as part of the cache key anywhere (legacy behavior), that would explain interleaving. We should not use referer in keys.

ryan: I checked code — in preview-prefetch we build key as `workspace + route + url` but older middleware used `origin` fallback. There's a guard but I can see a path where when `x-workspace-id` present but prefetch sets `x-prefetch: true` and rewriter strips x-workspace-id, the fallback uses referer substring. I'll open a quick PR.

ryan: Also, console router does a header normalize step on quick-switch that runs async; a timing window exists where upstream cache receives request without normalized headers.

marco: minimal repro: disable client-side prefetch and do rapid switch -> bug disappears.

jess: good find. Short-term: revert referer usage in cache key or add strict header validation that rejects prefetch responses if x-workspace-id mismatches route.

sara: Agreed. We should also add an integration test that simulates rapid-switch with concurrent prefetch and assert no cross-workspace rows.

ryan: I'll open PR+test: will add middleware assert `x-workspace-id` present and matches url param, and make cache key strictly `workspace:id|route|user` so referer never used.

marco: thanks. tagging @deploy-bot — staging patch candidate after review?

deploy-bot: Deploy triggered for branch fix/preview-prefetch-key-guard to staging. Build 9412 queued. :rocket:

jess: post-PR note: we should also scan other cache wrappers for referer/origin fallbacks. I can run a grep across repo.

sara: nice. create a follow-up ticket to audit other endpoints like runlist and quickpreview.

marco: created ticket WEB-7234 Audit cache key fallbacks for referer/origin. Adding repro GIF and trace. :white_check_mark:

ryan: PR opened -> #3842. Assigning reviewers jess,sara.

marco: will monitor staging after build. if anything odd, will paste logs here.
